invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破87（新止损位），或融资费率Z-score升至100%以上（轧多风险剧增）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 87 (new stop-loss), or funding Z-score rises above 100% (long squeeze risk surges).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破69000（基于ATR和日线支撑），或融资费率Z-score转正（空头压力缓解）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 69000 (based on ATR and daily support), or funding Z-score turns positive (short pressure eases).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2050（基于ATR和支撑），或融资费率Z-score转正超过-20%（空头压力缓解，挤压剧本失效）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2050 (based on ATR and support), or funding Z-score turns positive above -20% (short pressure eases, squeeze scenario invalid).
